10: “What made him think of going to Jerusalem?” he asked at last, repeating some words of my own.
8: I had nothing to lose now, so I began chattering the first thing that came into my head. The master remained silent as he gathered together the remains of the pen which I had left strewn about the table, looked gravely past my ear at the wall, and repeated from time to time, “Very well, very well.” Though I was conscious that I knew nothing whatever and was expressing myself all wrong, I felt much hurt at the fact that he never either corrected or interrupted me.
7: “Well, is that all you know?” he asked again, smiling.
5: I laughed in a rather forced manner.
1: “What?” “King, He took it into his head to go to Jerusalem, and handed over the reins of government to his mother.”
